items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: He was playing with Bill Hall. Bill Hall was in charge of the percussion section.

ctx.x: Oh, Paul Kosserbaum is an old time drummer, old New Orleanian from way back. He's a real nice boy. He... I didn't meet him until I came down to New Orleans and played in the symphony here. He was playing with Bill Hall. Bill Hall was in charge of the percussion section. And of course, invariably, there are two men back there, you know, to play the bass drum, the snare drums, the triangles, the bells, you know, how the percussion section is in the symphony orchestra. And I got to meet Paul Kosserbaum and he's a…
You don't remember any little anecdotes about him or Fontana or anybody else?
